answer: Reef-Lock Identity Cadence: each agent must emit its signed heartbeat on a randomized schedule seeded by its own key, and peers retain a rolling echo of recent cadence hashes. Duplicate keys forced to share one schedule collide on timing, exposing the clone. Registering a fresh identity demands completing a seeded fable of twenty verifiable micro-tasks, costing roughly 40 minutes of compute and $3 in fees per identity, making mass sybils uneconomical.
